description: Find SEC-registered public companies by ticker or name. Matching ignores case, punctuation, '&' vs 'and' and legal suffixes (Inc/Inc./Corp/Corporation/Co/Company/LLC/Ltd...), tolerates typos ('Microsfot' -> Microsoft) and knows well-known former names (matched_former_name, e.g. 'Facebook' -> Meta Platforms). Returns CIK (the SEC id used by every other tool), name, tickers, exchange and a match score (100 = exact ticker, 97 = exact name, < 80 = fuzzy). With no match it returns did_you_mean suggestions. Source: SEC company_tickers_exchange.json (companies with a listed ticker only); private or non-SEC companies: use lookup_business_entity.

query.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. 'MSFT', 'berkshire', 'Tesla Inc', 'Johnson and Johnson'
